div.head: II Cn 75.2
div.ab: ⁊ wite se oðer, þe þæt weorc geworhte, þæt he hit bete, swa swa lagan tæcean.
⁊ wite se oðor, þe þæt weorc geworhte, þæt he hit bete, swa swa lage tæce.
Et uideat alius, ut quod forisfecit emendet sic, sicut lex edocebit.
And wite se oðer þe þæt weorc geweorhte, þæt he hit bete, swa swa lagu tæce.
And the other who wrought the mischief shall see to it that he pays compensation for it, according as the law directs.
And the other, who did the deed, is to understand that he is to pay compensation for it as the laws direct.
Und der andere, der die [Misse]that verübt hat, begreife, dass er sie büsse, so wie die Rechtssatzung vorschreibt (-ungen vorschreiben G).
And let the other, who committed the [mis]deed, understand that he must atone for it as the law prescribes (the laws prescribe, G).
div.note: G's ‘lagan’ was altered from ‘laga’ (compare 83); the other MSS have the singular.
